text: Binary: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not the OP's) explicitly quotes (verbatim or near-verbatim, in quotation marks or block quote) or explicitly references a specific identifiable textual element of the OP's title/argument (a sentence, phrase, claim, example or passage, e.g. "you say that...", "your point about X"). Endorsement or refutation not required; merely discussing the general topic without pointing to specific OP text doesn't count. Title and argument are context for matching. Output 0 if the list is valid and no comment does so, or if it is a valid empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if a negative can't be established because title/argument is missing (a positive match against available OP text is still 1). Ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates or text reporting the outcome, even in the argument; generic delta/platform-rule discussion remains eligible. Marked edits in current text are usable; list order carries no chronology or rank.
